summary: Senior Unity Developer with 8+ years in games and 100+ games shipped across commercial MMORPGs and casual/simulation mobile production. I take game concepts from rapid prototypes through production, optimization, and release, using my own tools and AI-agent skills to accelerate delivery. The public portfolio shows selected work from that broader delivery history.

Built multiplayer systems, resource loading, and SDK integration for broad device coverage.
Delivered faction progression and large-scale PvP content alongside mobile optimization.
muloren: Built quest, class, and monster-spawning systems within a collaborative team.
Profiled and optimized mobile gameplay; integrated UI, in-game events, and battle systems.
sandwich: Built sandwich assembly, order handling, and customer-service systems for an idle simulation loop.
Connected gameplay UI and feedback with target-device optimization and player analytics for mobile delivery.
dalgona: Led technical delivery of core mechanics, difficulty progression, and win/lose logic within a team of 15.
Built animated UI and rankings; optimized World App mini-app integration and maintained published updates.
sudoku: Implemented puzzle generation and validation across four difficulty levels.
Connected daily challenges, hints, undo, saved progress, and offline play with mobile UI, dark mode, optimization, and publishing.
MeowFlow: Built path-connection puzzle rules and level progression with clear gameplay UI and feedback.
Integrated analytics and optimized performance for mobile delivery.
gamestudio-codexkit: Built MOStudio Kit (beta): AI skills and evidence-first workflows for Unity, C++/Lua MMORPG services, databases, and release operations.
Developed Python maintenance tools and deterministic routing evaluations with explicit evidence states and mutation gates.
proxyapi-mad: Independently integrated and adapted the upstream CLIProxyAPI foundation for agent workflows.
Connected provider configuration, API-key dashboards, request logs, and management UI/backend operations.
brproxies: Built the Rust/Tauri launcher and React/TypeScript browser-profile and proxy workspace.
Connected CDP handoff, local HTTP automation, MCP, and Python/Node SDKs with cross-platform runtime and release delivery.
